nodes.description: Private address state variable holding the privileged owner account, written in the constructor and in changeOwner, read by isOwner modifier and getOwner.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as the authorization subject in the isOwner modifier and as the initial owner in the constructor.
constructor(): assigns owner = msg.sender and emits OwnerSet(address(0), owner); sets the deployer as privileged owner.
isOwner modifier: performs require(msg.sender == owner, "Caller is not owner") as the access-control gate applied to changeOwner.
changeOwner(address newOwner) public isOwner: privileged ownership transfer guarded by the isOwner modifier; emits OwnerSet and overwrites the owner state variable.
getOwner() external view: read-only function returning the current owner state variable.
newOwner address parameter of changeOwner; becomes the new owner state value and is emitted in OwnerSet.
Privileged state write 'owner = newOwner' inside changeOwner that reassigns contract ownership; sensitive because it transfers full control of the contract.
State write 'owner = msg.sender' inside the constructor that grants ownership to the deployer without any prior authorization check.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read in the constructor and stored as the privileged owner, giving the deployer unchecked control over the contract.
The isOwner modifier consumes msg.sender in require(msg.sender == owner) to decide whether the caller is authorized.
The owner state variable is read inside the require comparison that gates privileged execution, coupling authorization to mutable state.
The isOwner modifier controls whether changeOwner body executes, making the modifier the effective access-control decision point.
The caller identity msg.sender indirectly reaches changeOwner through the modifier check, authorizing the ownership transfer.
The newOwner parameter is passed into changeOwner and used throughout its body.
The newOwner parameter is the value assigned into the owner state variable by the sensitive ownership-transfer write.
Execution of changeOwner leads to the privileged ownership-assignment operation guarded solely by the modifier.
The constructor assignment writes the msg.sender value into the owner state variable.
The constructor unconditionally executes the ownership-granting state write during deployment.
changeOwner mutates the owner state variable, changing who controls the contract's privileged operations.
getOwner reads the owner state variable and returns it to the caller.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a non-core parameter whose only role is to feed the changeOwner function and its ownership-assignment write, so it collapses into the changeOwner function node.
